name: 29627-decodeheavy-granite7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one vLLM engine, one GPU.
architecture: GraniteMoeHybridForCausalLM: 40 layers (36 mamba, 4 attention), hidden 1536, 12 query / 4 KV heads, 62 experts with 6 active per token plus a shared expert, ~7B total and ~1B active, bf16, context window 131072.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), 8 streams, warmup 25%, bounded at 128 requests with a 1800 s safety cap, seed static 29627.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`, one turn, 128 prompt tokens in and 2048 out, every request the same size (min == max on both, so all 2048 tokens are always generated). Prompts are random and mutually distinct, so nothing is shared between them. The prompt is tokenized with add_special_tokens=True, so the engine's own count reads ~128-131 rather than 128 exactly.
purpose: A long-form story generator writing 2048-token continuations from short prompts for eight concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# The engine is a commit, not a release: `git describe --tags` on
# 254a7f8fd613d6b6964abc277b73ca1f0b823cdb gives v0.13.0rc1-195-g254a7f8fd613, so the built
# checkout is named by `configs/env.yaml: venv` rather than by a version.

model: ibm-granite/granite-4.0-tiny-preview

enable-prefix-caching: true

tensor-parallel-size: 1

# The workload's worst case is 128 prompt tokens plus 2048 generated; the checkpoint's window is
# 131072, which would size the KV pool for a length this item never reaches.
max-model-len: 4096
